request.subject: PORTRAIT:SWORDSMAN

layers.text: Change the shading only, so that he is lit from the left: the left half of the steel helm and of its face plate is the brightest pale polished steel, the right half is darker steel in shadow; the left side of the crimson crest is brighter red and its right side darker; the left edge of the sword blade is bright and its right edge dark. Do not change any shape: keep the helm, gold cross, crest, pauldron, gauntlets, tabard, sword, outline and art style the same, on a transparent background.
